title: Common Issues and Troubleshooting
content:
Solutions to frequently encountered issues:

**Login Problems:**

Q: I can't log in with SSO
A: Ensure your IT admin has added Symbol-U to your identity provider. Check that your email domain matches the configured SSO domain.

Q: My session keeps expiring
A: Session timeout is set by your admin (default 8 hours). Contact your admin to adjust if needed.

**Performance Issues:**

Q: Responses are slow
A: Check your network connection. If using VPN, try direct connection. Large context windows (>50K tokens) may have higher latency.

Q: The UI is unresponsive
A: Clear browser cache and cookies. Disable browser extensions. Try incognito mode.

**API Errors:**

Q: Getting 429 Too Many Requests
A: You've hit rate limits. Implement exponential backoff. Consider upgrading your tier for higher limits.

Q: Getting 401 Unauthorized
A: API key may be expired or revoked. Generate a new key from Settings.

**Data Issues:**

Q: Search results seem outdated
A: Document indexing runs every 4 hours. Force a re-index from Admin > Data Sources.

Q: Missing expected results
A: Check document permissions. Ensure the content is in a supported format.
